title: A turn whose every write read its words back on the page is not redrawn and judged again
steps: S1: run the visual check on a turn whose only writes are content.replace answers verified "shown on …".
S2: the same with a write that did not verify, or that wrote companions or failed a contact.
S3: a verified write to a shared part whose pages are held as extras.
expect: S1: the check is skipped as verified-on-page; no picture is drawn and no judge is asked.
evidence: Issue #209: a one-word replace already read back on the page waited for a redraw and a judge that reported it not shown

tests: a turn whose every write read its words back on the page is not redrawn or judged (#209)
the check still runs when a write did not prove itself, or touched more than its words (#209)
a verified write to a shared part (pages of it held as extras) is still checked (#209)
